WHAT: App.tsx applies dark theme unconditionally via a single useEffect
WHERE: src/App.tsx (replaced ~lines 477-529)
HOW:
```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  document.documentElement.classList.add(darkTheme);
  return () => { document.documentElement.classList.remove(darkTheme); };
}, []);
```
WHY: Removed two useEffects that previously handled light/dark/system — one for initial load, one reactive to settings changes
GOTCHA: Check if `settings` and `isLoadingSettings` from useSettingsStore() are used elsewhere in App.tsx before removing those destructured values — only remove if theme was their sole purpose
